_comment: Canonical inventory counts for Project Athena. Single source of truth for pre-commit caps, audit asserts, and AGENTS.md regeneration. Update via .agent/scripts/sync_agents_md.py (runs automatically: pre-commit Gate 4 + shutdown.py Phase 1.5), not by hand.

protocols.cap_policy: Protocols are uncapped as of v9.8.0. The constraint is on BOOT LOAD (attention budget), not on total count. Protocol 530 (Conditional Skill Loading) + Progressive Disclosure ensure only relevant protocols enter context per session. Archived protocols don't affect boot. TD-019 is now structurally resolved.

workflows.cap_policy: Workflows are uncapped as of v9.8.0. Domain workflows are dormant by default (_domain/ tier) and only activate on query match. The constraint is attention budget, not inventory size. TD-017 is now structurally resolved.

canonical.cap_policy: Entry count is uncapped as of 2026-05-07 (GTO alignment with protocols/workflows). The constraint is boot-load attention budget (~35K token ceiling / ~140KB), not entry count. Staleness thresholds (3mo/6mo) + quarterly /audit-canonical are the quality gates. Tiered loading ensures only relevant entries enter context per session.

recount_rules._note: All rules exclude README.md so archive marker files don't inflate counts.
